verdict.rationale: Automatically choosing the cheapest configuration that still succeeds is a fair pricing question for a browser-infrastructure API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes automatic cost-based configuration selection, such as tiered fallback across proxies, stealth, or browser settings. The Optimize tool turns a completed Agent run into a reusable script or a better system prompt; it is a manual dashboard step, not the API selecting a cheaper configuration.
